prompt: If you have any problem with your parcel, please call our helpline. → Should you …
answer: Should you have any problem with your parcel, please call our helpline.
accepted_answers: Should you have any problem with your parcel, please call our helpline.
explanation_ru: В формальном стиле if в условии с возможным событием заменяется инверсией: Should you have … (без will и без do).

prompt: Make one correct sentence.
answer: Had I known about the strike, I would have cycled to work.
accepted_answers: Had I known about the strike, I would have cycled to work.
explanation_ru: Это нереальное прошлое: вместо If I had known ставится Had I known, затем would have + V3.

prompt: ___ the taxi driver's phone call, we would have missed our flight.
options: If it would not have been for
explanation_ru: Речь о прошлом (would have missed), поэтому нужно Had it not been for; Were it not for относится к настоящему, а Had not it — неверный порядок слов.

prompt: Should you will need a receipt, please ask at the front desk.
answer: Should you need a receipt, please ask at the front desk.
accepted_answers: Should you need a receipt, please ask at the front desk.
explanation_ru: После инверсии Should you стоит глагол в основной форме: need, без will.

prompt: Dear parents, ___ (it / to be possible), we would gladly change the date of the school trip, but the coach company has no free buses in May.
explanation_ru: Автобусов нет, значит условие нереально сейчас: If it were possible превращается в Were it possible.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Had it not been for Mustafa, we would have got lost.
accepted_answers: Had it not been for Mustafa, we would have got lost.
explanation_ru: Had it not been for … — инверсия вместо If it hadn't been for …; отрицание not стоит после it.

prompt: If I had checked the weather forecast, we wouldn't have got wet on the hill. → Had I …
answer: Had I checked the weather forecast, we wouldn't have got wet on the hill.
accepted_answers: Had I checked the weather forecast, we wouldn't have got wet on the hill.
Had I checked the weather forecast, we would not have got wet on the hill.
Had I checked the weather forecast, we wouldn't have gotten wet on the hill.
Had I checked the weather forecast, we would not have gotten wet on the hill.
explanation_ru: If опускается, had выходит на первое место перед подлежащим; главная часть остаётся без изменений.

prompt: I would ban sweet drinks if I were in charge of the school canteen. → Were I …
answer: Were I in charge of the school canteen, I would ban sweet drinks.
accepted_answers: Were I in charge of the school canteen, I would ban sweet drinks.
Were I in charge of the school canteen, I'd ban sweet drinks.
explanation_ru: Во втором условном If I were превращается в Were I; главная часть не меняется.

prompt: Honestly, ___ the museum closed at four, I would have gone in the morning.
explanation_ru: Инверсия для нереального прошлого: Had + подлежащее + V3. Did I know, If had I и Had known I — неверные формы.

prompt: Had not I seen the sign, I would have driven straight into the closed road.
answer: Had I not seen the sign, I would have driven straight into the closed road.
accepted_answers: Had I not seen the sign, I would have driven straight into the closed road.
explanation_ru: В инверсии not ставится после подлежащего: Had I not seen, а не Had not I seen.

prompt: The ferry left without us. ___ (we / to leave) ten minutes earlier, we would have caught it.
explanation_ru: Паром уже ушёл, это нереальное прошлое: If we had left → Had we left.

prompt: Build the sentence.
answer: Should you lose your key, call the office at once.
accepted_answers: Should you lose your key, call the office at once.
explanation_ru: Should you + глагол — формальное «если вдруг»; после запятой идёт повелительное наклонение.

prompt: My phone is very slow. I wish I (to have) a new one.
explanation_ru: Желание о настоящем, которое не соответствует действительности: wish + Past Simple (had).

prompt: I can't open this jar. → I wish I …
answer: I wish I could open this jar.
accepted_answers: I wish I could open this jar.
I wish I was able to open this jar.
I wish I were able to open this jar.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о неумении или невозможности в настоящем выражается через wish + could.

prompt: The ticket machine only takes coins, and I have only a card. I wish I ___ a ticket from it.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о невозможности сейчас: wish + could. Can и would после wish не используются.

prompt: Priti works until nine every evening, so she can't go to the language classes. She wishes she (to be able to / attend) them.
explanation_ru: Приходить на занятия она не может сейчас, поэтому после wishes нужно could attend (или were able to attend).

prompt: My grandmother speaks Polish beautifully. I wish I can speak it like her.
answer: My grandmother speaks Polish beautifully. I wish I could speak it like her.
accepted_answers: My grandmother speaks Polish beautifully. I wish I could speak it like her.
explanation_ru: После wish нельзя использовать can: для умения в настоящем нужен could.

prompt: Jude lives in a small village where only one bus a day goes to town, and he finds this very inconvenient. Which sentence fits?
options: Jude wishes he lived in a town with more buses.
Jude wishes he lives in a town with more buses.
Jude wishes he will live in a town with more buses.
Jude wishes he would live in a town with more buses.
explanation_ru: Желание о нынешней ситуации выражается через wish + Past Simple (lived); will, would и настоящее время после wish не ставятся.

prompt: I wish my brother lived closer to us.
options: My brother lives close to us, and we are happy.
My brother lived far away, but now he lives closer.
My brother lives far from us.
My brother will move closer to us soon.
explanation_ru: Wish + Past Simple означает, что в реальности всё наоборот и сейчас: брат живёт далеко.

prompt: Ines moved to Cardiff in September. 'I wish I (to know) more people here,' she tells her mum on the phone. 'And I wish I (not / to sell) my old flat last spring. I could still be living there!' Her mum says, 'You can always come home for the weekend.' 'I wish I (to be able to / do) that, but the train costs too much,' says Ines.
explanation_ru: Три разных желания: сейчас (knew), о прошлом событии (hadn't sold) и о невозможности сейчас (could do).

prompt: I didn't take an umbrella this morning, and now I'm wet. I wish I (to take) one.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом действии (утром не взял зонт): wish + Past Perfect.

prompt: I miss the old bike I sold last year; it was perfect. I wish I didn't sell it.
answer: I miss the old bike I sold last year; it was perfect. I wish I hadn't sold it.
accepted_answers: I miss the old bike I sold last year; it was perfect. I wish I hadn't sold it.
I miss the old bike I sold last year; it was perfect. I wish I had not sold it.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о прошлом событии (last year) требует wish + Past Perfect: hadn't sold.

prompt: Olumide stayed at the party until three in the morning and then overslept on the day of his driving test. Now he wishes he ___ home earlier.
explanation_ru: Сожаление о том, что уже произошло, выражается через wish + Past Perfect (had gone); went относится к настоящему, would go — к раздражению.

prompt: We lost the match 1–0, and our goalkeeper dropped an easy ball. If only he (to catch) it!
explanation_ru: Матч уже проигран, это сожаление о прошлом: If only + Past Perfect.

prompt: I don't remember Marit's phone number. → If only I …
answer: If only I remembered Marit's phone number.
accepted_answers: If only I remembered Marit's phone number.
If only I could remember Marit's phone number.
explanation_ru: If only о настоящей ситуации: Past Simple (remembered) или could remember.

prompt: My laptop freezes every ten minutes. If only I ___ enough money for a new one.
explanation_ru: If only о нынешней нехватке денег требует Past Simple: had.

prompt: My brother never answers my messages. I wish he ___ back sometimes.
explanation_ru: Раздражение чужим поведением и желание, чтобы оно изменилось, выражается через wish + would.

prompt: Quentin, you always talk over me. I wish you will stop doing it.
answer: Quentin, you always talk over me. I wish you would stop doing it.
accepted_answers: Quentin, you always talk over me. I wish you would stop doing it.
explanation_ru: Раздражение чужой привычкой — wish + would; will после wish не употребляется.

prompt: It has rained for six days, and Wendell is tired of it. What does he say?
options: I wish it will stop raining.
I wish it would stop raining.
I wish it had stopped raining.
explanation_ru: Хочется, чтобы дождь наконец прекратился: wish + would stop. Will и настоящее время после wish не ставятся.

prompt: Sasha keeps borrowing my charger and never gives it back. I wish he (to give) it back for once!
explanation_ru: Раздражение чужим поведением: wish + would give (допустимо и gave).

prompt: It's late, Sunil. It's time you (to turn) off the computer and (to go) to bed.
explanation_ru: После It's time you употребляется Past Simple, хотя речь о настоящем моменте: turned, went.

prompt: Look at the clock, children! It's time you ___ to bed.
explanation_ru: После It's time + подлежащее нужна форма прошедшего времени: went (значение настоящее).

prompt: It is high time the council repairs this road, because the holes have been getting bigger every week and nobody seems to care.
answer: It is high time the council repaired this road, because the holes have been getting bigger every week and nobody seems to care.
accepted_answers: It is high time the council repaired this road, because the holes have been getting bigger every week and nobody seems to care.
explanation_ru: После It is high time + подлежащее глагол ставится в Past Simple: repaired, а не repairs.

prompt: I'd rather you (to park) round the corner, please. The delivery van needs space in front of the gate.
explanation_ru: Would rather с другим подлежащим: Past Simple (parked) с настоящим или будущим значением.

prompt: Honestly, I'd rather ___ at home tonight than go to the cinema.
explanation_ru: Когда подлежащее одно и то же, после would rather идёт инфинитив без to: stay.

prompt: Please don't use my laptop without asking. → I'd rather you …
answer: I'd rather you didn't use my laptop without asking.
accepted_answers: I'd rather you didn't use my laptop without asking.
I would rather you didn't use my laptop without asking.
I'd rather you did not use my laptop without asking.
I would rather you did not use my laptop without asking.
I'd rather you not use my laptop without asking.
I would rather you not use my laptop without asking.
explanation_ru: После would rather с другим подлежащим ставится Past Simple: didn't use.

prompt: Ezra talks to me as if I (to be) a child, but I am thirty-five.
explanation_ru: Это неправда (я не ребёнок), поэтому после as if — форма were (допустимо и was).

prompt: Bethan came out of the exam smiling as if she ___ the best mark in the class, but later we heard she had failed.
explanation_ru: Нереальное сравнение о прошлом: as if + Past Perfect (had got). Настоящее время здесь не подходит.

prompt: She spoke to the waiter as if he is her servant.
answer: She spoke to the waiter as if he were her servant.
accepted_answers: She spoke to the waiter as if he were her servant.
She spoke to the waiter as if he was her servant.
explanation_ru: Официант не её слуга, сравнение нереальное: после as if нужна форма were (was), а не is.

prompt: Lenka stood in the doorway as though she (not / to hear) a word of our argument, but we all knew she had been listening at the door.
explanation_ru: Мы знаем, что она слушала, значит сравнение нереальное и о прошлом: as though + Past Perfect.

prompt: Which world is each sentence about?

items.text: If the gate is locked, use the side door.
If you press this button, the lift comes.
If Rhys is late again, the boss will be angry.
If Rhys were on time, the boss would be happier.
If the gate had been open, we would have walked through.
If I lived by the sea, I would swim every day.
I wish I had a garden.

explanation_ru: Present Simple после if описывает реальность и возможное; Past Simple, Past Perfect и wish + прошедшая форма — нереальный мир.

prompt: Which situation is each sentence about?

items.text: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
If you take the 8.15 train, you will arrive before noon.
If I were taller, I could reach the top shelf.
If the lift weren't broken, we wouldn't be climbing eight floors.
I wish the neighbours were quieter.
If Tilda had left earlier, she would have caught the train.
I wish I had listened to my father.

explanation_ru: Present Simple + will — реальная возможность; Past Simple — нереально сейчас; Past Perfect — нереально в прошлом.

prompt: Gwen forgot her wallet yesterday, so she walked to work instead of taking the bus. Which sentence fits?
options: If Gwen had taken her wallet, she would have taken the bus.
If Gwen took her wallet, she would take the bus.
If Gwen takes her wallet, she will take the bus.
If Gwen had taken her wallet, she would take the bus.
explanation_ru: Вчерашнее событие уже не изменить, нужна третья модель: had taken … would have taken.

prompt: Kieran's sister texted that she is probably coming on Saturday. He is planning the day. Which sentence fits?
options: If she comes, we will go to the market.
If she came, we would go to the market.
If she had come, we would have gone to the market.
If she will come, we go to the market.
explanation_ru: Приезд реально возможен, поэтому If + Present Simple и will; will после if не ставится.

prompt: Gideon didn't study architecture, so he works in a bank now, and he is bored. Which sentence fits?
options: If Gideon studied architecture, he wouldn't have worked in a bank.
If Gideon were to study architecture, he wouldn't be working in a bank.
If Gideon had studied architecture, he wouldn't be working in a bank now.
If Gideon had studied architecture, he wouldn't have been working in a bank now.
explanation_ru: Условие относится к прошлому (не учился), а результат — к настоящему (работает сейчас): had studied … wouldn't be working.

prompt: Maybe Lamar has my new number. If he ___ it, he will call me tonight.
explanation_ru: Это реальная возможность (я не знаю), поэтому после if — Present Simple: has.

prompt: The party was great! If you ___ with us, you would have enjoyed it.
explanation_ru: Вечеринка уже прошла, поэтому в придаточном нужен Past Perfect: had come.

prompt: If Pilar had taken the job in Madrid, she would be living near her sister now.
options: Pilar took the job in Madrid and lives near her sister.
Pilar didn't take the job in Madrid, but she lives near her sister.
Pilar didn't take the job in Madrid and doesn't live near her sister.
Pilar didn't take the job in Madrid and didn't live near her sister then.
explanation_ru: Условие о прошлом (не взяла работу), результат о настоящем (не живёт рядом): в реальности обе части отрицательные, каждая в своём времени.

prompt: Match the halves about a snowy week in the village.
pairs: If it snowed more often here,
If it had snowed last night,
the school would have been closed.
explanation_ru: Каждая часть задаёт свой мир: реальное будущее — will, нереальное сейчас — would, нереальное прошлое — would have + V3, раздражение — wish + would.

prompt: A message about a missed wedding.
sentences: Last Saturday I missed my cousin's wedding because my car broke down.
If I had checked the oil before the trip, the engine would not have failed.
She is angry with me now, and if I would see her tomorrow, I will have to apologise.
I wish I would have called her at once.
From now on, I will check the car before every long trip.

fixes.2: She is angry with me now, and if I see her tomorrow, I will have to apologise.
fixes.3: I wish I had called her at once.

explanation_ru: В предложении 2 после if нельзя would: встреча возможна, нужен Present Simple; в предложении 3 сожаление о прошлом — wish + Past Perfect, а не would have.

prompt: If the delivery had arrived on time, we would be using the new table now.
answer: If the delivery had arrived on time, we would be using the new table now.
accepted_answers: If the delivery had arrived on time, we would be using the new table now.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: условие относится к прошлому (had arrived), результат — к настоящему (would be using).

prompt: Last Friday Rowan's phone died on the way to the airport because he forgot to charge it. 'If I (to charge) it the night before, I (to find) the right gate easily,' he says now. 'Next time I (to check) the battery before I (to leave) home,' he adds.
explanation_ru: Прошлое, которое нельзя изменить: had charged … would have found; реальный план на будущее: will check, а после before — Present Simple (leave).
